deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes the specific subject 'this meningioma' to a general subject 'A meningioma', which widens the scope of the claim from a specific instance to meningiomas in general.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this meningioma obviously is occurring within the skull.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A meningioma occurs within the skull,

deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds the word 'so' to explicitly state a causal link between the skull being a confined space and the tumour putting pressure on the brain, whereas the text only places the statements next to each other.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: The skull is a confined space. This would put an enormous amount of pressure
deficiencies.rewritePassage: which is a confined space, so it puts an enormous amount of pressure

considerations.sourcePassage: everybody gets very nervous about what that diagnosis is going to look like.
considerations.reason: Paraphrasing this to 'there is considerable anxiety about the diagnosis' uses different words with exactly the same meaning, which is allowed.

considerations.sourcePassage: But things like the smooth muscle fibroid that I showed you,
considerations.reason: Changing this to 'whereas a smooth muscle fibroid, as shown earlier' is a valid paraphrase that uses different words with the same meaning and correctly translates the lecturer's reference to the slide.

considerations.sourcePassage: So things like meningiomas can cause that.
considerations.reason: The rewrite changes this to 'Meningiomas can therefore have this effect', which correctly keeps the meaning of the result link ('So' to 'therefore') and the reference ('that' to 'this effect').
